name: cmdb_cientity_inspect
label: Inventory Inspection Status Table
description: The inspection status table for configuration items can be used for related queries in configuration management and other reporting scenarios.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Primary key, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: job_id
fields.description: Job ID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: ci_entity_id
fields.description: Configuration item ID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_cientity_id
indexes.description: Standard index covering the ci_entity_id field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: uk_job_id_cientity_id
indexes.description: Unique index covering the job_id, ci_entity_id fields, suitable for exact-match retrieval, uniqueness checks, and duplicate detection.
